name: A Thread in the Thorns
introduction: Mara watches the trees. 'The wolf has taken the north track. Drive it off, and bring me word. There is something in the chapel you ought to see.'
progress: The pine track is quiet. Mara should hear what happened.
completion: Mara listens without moving. Then she puts the candle in your hand. 'I thought I wanted the bell to ring again,' she says. 'Now I should like to know who has been listening.' She opens the chapel gate.
